canyon: Actual extracted Canyon layout has snow-covered basin bounded by steep dark rock faces, large recessed northern Nuclear Warhead Storage Building roller door, industrial cylindrical service machinery on the right, and small rocks at the southern approach.
M1 cutscene confirms cold cyan game lighting and snow ground.
Do not replace with heliport, hangar interior, Sniper Wolf snowfield or another remake.
towerB: Actual gameplay shows a flat rectangular roof, large rectangular access hut, faceted water-tank cover, open white metal perimeter guardrails, patches of metal grating and dark snowy night sky.
Extracted tower map distinguishes large satellite dish of Tower A from the Hind fight roof of Tower B. Do not put Tower A dish on the playable B roof.
The red ellipse in a guide annotation, the HUD, scope marks and route-map annotations must not appear in the produced scene.
mgrR00: Five actual released R00 gameplay captures were viewed. References7,11,13 are the first RAY street, with the damaged tower, right civic facade, trees, palms, smoke and distant wind turbine.
Do not conflate this street with R01 Abkhazia, the later rail sequence, or an unrelated modern city.

limits: Original-style 1998 MGS1 geometry is established by the extracted PlayStation maps and actual gameplay. Screenshot hosting does not certify the exact renderer/platform or unfiltered PS1 color.
A horizontal fighter camera, widened clear combat lane and cosmetic cover placement are explicit CQC adaptations.
No image generated here is a lossless recovery of historical P53 missing files or a pixel-perfect certification.
